CCNP Routing

My notes from studying for the retired Cisco CCNP ROUTE exam, covering IP routing, OSPF, EIGRP, BGP, MPLS L3VPN, GRE, IPsec, and DMVPN.

I wrote these notes while studying for the Cisco CCNP ROUTE exam between December 2017 and January 2018, and I originally published them on my GitHub. They follow the exam blueprint of that era, working from IP routing fundamentals through OSPF, EIGRP, and BGP into MPLS L3VPN and VPN technologies such as GRE, IPsec, and DMVPN.

NoteArchived Notes

Cisco retired the CCNP Routing and Switching track in February 2020 and replaced it with CCNP Enterprise. I have kept these pages close to how I first wrote them, with only light formatting cleanup. Each page carries the date I wrote it, and the command output comes from the IOS versions I was running at the time. The concepts (OSPF, EIGRP, BGP, MPLS) remain as relevant as ever.
